limits.en: Stream to 2 channels simultaneously, includes Restream branding

keyLimits.en: Stream on 3 channels at once, removes branding, guest channel access
Multistream to 5 channels, full HD 1080p, 4K recording, dual-format streaming
Stream on 8 channels, website player with 1,000 concurrent viewers, 2 included team seats
SSO, dedicated account management, unlimited capabilities

addOns.en: Clips add-on: from $19/mo (50 clips) up to $59/mo (250 clips) depending on plan
Webinars add-on: from $99/mo (100 attendees) up to $299/mo (500 attendees) depending on plan

cautions.en: Annual billing gives a 20% discount across all paid plans, but the page shows monthly prices by default.

capabilities.en: Simultaneous multi-platform live streaming (multistreaming) to several social/video platforms at once
Studio for co-hosting guests and branded overlays
4K recording and dual horizontal/vertical format streaming on Professional plan

limitations.en: Free plan limited to 2 simultaneous channels and carries Restream branding
Clips and Webinars are paid add-ons on top of the base plan price, not included by default

reason.en: Overlapping use case for repurposing live/video content into clips
